accuracyFlags: Homepage body and FAQ say 'Street View' in 11 places (feature card 'Street View before the turnoff', 'Street View, weather and directions built in', FAQ 'Street View still need a connection'); the app uses Apple Look Around, so every instance is wrong (the FAQ JSON-LD already says Look Around, so page and schema disagree).

Copy such as 'stack filters until only the free camping areas with toilets and water in your corner of the map are left' and 'Search 74,000+ places' never states that campgrounds, rest areas, dump points and water need the Pass (only BookEasy stays/tours are free); no honest free/Pass line anywhere on the page.
Meta description is about 180 chars (limit 155) and promises 'free camps' without the Pass boundary.

proposed.title: AussieCamps: Australia Camping Map & Road Trip Planner
proposed.meta: Find campgrounds, caravan parks, rest areas and dump points across Australia. Place details work offline; plan stop-by-stop road trips on iPhone.
proposed.h1: Australia is big, your plan can be simple
addSections: Replace every 'Street View' with 'Apple Look Around' (feature card, bullets, FAQ)
'What is free and what needs the Pass' block: BookEasy stays and tours free; campgrounds, rest areas, dump points, water, guides, collections and trips on the Pass
App screenshot of the place screen plus desktop QR to the App Store
proposed.cta: Download on the App Store, with a one-line Pass explainer under the button

notes: Testimonials, user counts and headline place totals ignored (owner out of scope). Offline claim is correctly scoped (place details and guides, not maps) in FAQ. Only 2 clicks / 70 impressions at position 21, so the main prize here is the P0 fact fix rather than CTR. JSON-LD Organization/WebSite/MobileApplication present; 5 reviews stars out of scope.
